text:
Samir: Follow-up thread from today's all-hands. Posting concise Q&A on the headcount/orgh changes.
Priya: Quick: is hiring frozen or re-prioritized?
Samir: Re-prioritized. We're pausing low-impact reqs for ~60 days and creating a small Strategic Capacity Pool for infra, runtime, SRE, and customer-critical work.
Javi: Practical number: 7 pooled slots for Q2, mostly infra/runtime and 1 senior SWE. Manager reqs only for backfills or clear scaling needs.
Maya: What happens to offers in flight (unsigned)?
Priya: Unsigned offers are reviewed case-by-case; signed offers are honored. Recruiters will reach out within 3 business days if anything changes.
Omar: If my pod loses a slot, what's the timeline for redeploy vs severance?
Priya: Step 1: 7-business-day internal redeploy window. Step 2: if no match, HR provides transition support per policy. We're prioritizing internal moves.
Maya: Interview loop changes?
Javi: Non-core roles may move to a condensed loop (one panel + take-home). Senior/platform roles keep the full loop.
Omar: Exceptions for SLA/customer blockers?
Samir: Submit a 2-line exception with owner sign-off to people-ops and CC me. SLA-impacting ones get a 48h fast-track; revenue-critical can be same-day with exec sponsor.
PeopleOpsBot: HR drop-in hours Wed 11am PT and Thu 3pm PT. Exception form and provisional req status sheet will be posted to #people-ops by EOD.
Samir: We'll publish a provisional pod-level map Monday. If you need a private conversation, DM Priya or me. Keeping this short so it's easy to reference. :white_check_mark:
